meta.house_context: NBC News had called 416 of 435 House races as of 5:11 p.m. ET, Nov. 9. Among called races, 47 seats changed party (45 to Democrats, 2 to Republicans), as marked by NBC News or ABC News. ABC News marked 46 seats as party gains.
meta.notes: Unofficial. House percentages from the named results table; a district is called only when a source called it.
